key_points: Envestnet Asset Management sold HPQ shares, signaling institutional outflow.
HP launched AI-centric laptops (HP Googlebook 14 and ZBook Ultra G3a) to strengthen PC competitiveness.
Seeking Alpha downgraded HP, labeling the recent PC revenue burst as temporary.
Barchart warned of a PC industry decline in 2027, weighing on near‑term optimism.
Simply Wall St. noted HP raised its outlook but questioned whether the upside is already priced in.
